newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: SOCCER-ARTUR OLIVEIRA LEADS PORTO TO 2-1 WIN OVER GOTHENBURG.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ARTUR OLIVEIRA LEADS PORTO TO 2-1 WIN OVER GOTHENBURG.

text.p: Brazilian striker Artur Oliveira scored twice to give Porto a 2-1 victory over Sweden's Gothenburg on Wednesday and maintain the Portuguese side's 100 percent record in the European Cup Champions' League.

Artur, who had been in doubt due to injury, opened the scoring in the 27th minute when he fought off three defenders inside the box and shot home a powerful volley after a cross from compatriot Edmilson Pimenta.

In the 51st minute Artur scored his second with a classy header following a long shot from midfielder Paulinho Santos as Porto headed for their second Group D win in the Champions' League following their opening 3-2 victory away to AC Milan.

Gothenburg, beaten 3-2 by Norway's Rosenborg in their opening Champions' League match, pulled one back when Porto defender Jorge Costa scored an own goal in the 72nd minute trying to clear the ball from the area.
The Swedes passed up the chance of an early lead when striker Magnus Erlingmark popped up between two defenders inside the box only to shoot wide.
Then Mikael Nisson hit the post with a 30-metre free-kick in the 14th minute.
Two minutes later Porto's Brazilian striker Mario Jardel, who scored twice in the win over Milan, had a good shot cleared on the line by defender Jesper Blomqvist.
From then on the Portuguese champions began to take control, forcing Gothenburg's international goalkeeper Thomas Ravelli to make some excellent saves.
In the 75th minute, having clawed back to 2-1, Gothenburg claimed a penalty, saying Porto's Polish keeper Andrzej Wosniak had fouled Stefan Nilsson. But Turkish referee Ahmet Gakar disagreed.
In the final four minutes nerves became frayed on both sides and Gakar booked Porto's Luis Marcos and Ljubimko Drulovic and Gothenburg's Mikael Martissen.
After the match Porto coach Antonio Oliveira praised Ravelli but said his team had deserved their win.
"It was an undisputed victory. We had loads of chances to score but Gothenburg had an excellent keeper who played possibly the best game of his life," he said.

Porto - 1-Andrzej Wosniak, 7-Sergio Conceicao, 22-Jorge Costa, 13-Luis Marcos 'Lula', 3-Rui Jorge, 4-Aloisio Alves, 5-Fernando Mendes, 20-Paulinho Santos, 21-Edmilson Pimenta (Antonio Folha, 66th minute), 16-Mario Jardel (Ljumbinko Drulovic, 80th), 14-Artur Oliveira.

Gothenburg - 1-Thomas Ravelli, 4-Jonas Olsson, 6-Teddy Lucic, 9-Niclas Alexandersson, 10-Stefan Pettersson (Mikael Martinsson, 80th), 11-Stefan Lindqvist, 13-Mikael Nilsson, 14-Andreas Andersson, 16-Jesper Blomqvist, 19-Magnus Erlingmark, 22-Stefan Landberg.
